$comment: Canned replies for the stand-in platform (demo/fake-platform.js in the case desk engine), so this desk can be tried with no platform. Each key is a case title, matched without regard to case. The stand-in adds its own first line saying that the reply is canned. The replies follow the right answers in demo-insurer/SCENARIOS.md, and every id, date, amount, clause and working line in them is what the invented insurer returns when it is started with the date 26 Nov 2026. Two of them are short replies with no table and no proposal, as the agents give them. The insurer, its claimants and their documents are invented. Start the stand-in with DESK_CONFIG pointing at desk.config.json in this folder.

Summary
Claim CLM-4004: Odalys Fenwright, Motor: theft of the insured vehicle, loss on 19 Nov 2026.
Policy POL-2004, wording TMI-MOT-01 version 3. The policy was in force on 19 Nov 2026: the policy period runs from 23 Aug 2026 to 22 Aug 2027, and 19 Nov 2026 is inside it.
Clause 1.2 applies: the insured vehicle was stolen. The key was left in the ignition, and no clause of the wording speaks of a key left in the vehicle. Nothing is inferred from that.
For the adjuster to decide: what follows from the key left in the vehicle, on which the wording is silent. Clause 3.4 limits the hire car. No condition is unmet.
No recovery indicated: the file names nobody.

Dear Yvaine Corrimond,

We are writing about your claim CLM-4010. We are sorry to tell you that we are not able to pay the claim.

The reason is this. The home had been unoccupied for 74 days in a row when the loss happened.

Clause 2.2 of your policy wording says that this is not covered: "Loss or damage that happens after the home has been unoccupied for more than 60 days in a row."

If you think this decision is wrong, you can ask us to look at it again. Write to our Complaints Team within 8 weeks of the date of this letter and quote your claim id. If you are still unhappy after our reply, you can take your complaint to the Meridia Insurance Ombudsman.

Claims, Thornmere Mutual Insurance

Proposal: approve the letter
